bullets.title: ANTHROPIC SHIPPED A VERTICAL PRODUCT WHOSE ENTIRE SUBSTANCE IS NAMED WORKFLOW SKILLS PLUS CONNECTORS — "CLAUDE FOR FINANCIAL ADVISORS" (14 SEP), THE CONSTRUCT'S OWN ARCHITECTURE SOLD AS A SKU
bullets.summary: Archive grep: zero prior hits, genuinely new. Not a model and not an app — a suite of connectors plus workflow skills for advisor onboarding, alternative-investments briefing, compliance and AI-policy review, estate and tax briefing, portfolio-rebalance review, post-meeting notes and follow-up, pre-meeting prep, and prospect intake. Connectors to Charles Schwab, BlackRock, Addepar, Envestnet, iCapital, Orion, SS&C Black Diamond, Wealthbox, Wealth.com, Vanguard, Zocks, plus existing Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Docusign, Box, FactSet, S&P Global, Morningstar. Context four days older and so not its own bullet: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services on 10 Sep with Morgan Stanley and Evercore — two frontier labs went vertical into one industry inside five days.
bullets.how: YES — the most load-bearing item in a fortnight, and it cuts both ways. The SHAPE is validation: the unit of a vertical AI product is now a named skill per recurring professional workflow plus a connector per system of record, which is exactly what The Construct is (~130-file SKILL.md corpus) and exactly what PRAGMA sells. We no longer argue that skills-plus-connectors is a product architecture; Anthropic priced it. The COMPETITIVE half is the warning: the lab now ships vertical packs itself, top-down, per industry. No threat to signage, but it is the clock on any PRAGMA vertical a lab finds worth productizing. Defensible ground is what a lab cannot ship from headquarters — documented relationships, local provenance, client-proprietary workflow. One concrete pull: read the eight named skill titles as an external granularity standard; our corpus has never been audited against one.

bullets.title: "NOTHING SHIPPED" ENDED AT FIVE DAYS — CLAUDE CODE 2.1.271 LANDED 14 SEPTEMBER, AND TWO OF ITS ITEMS ARE CONFIG THIS REPORT HAS BEEN ASKING FOR
bullets.summary: Archive grep on 2.1.271 and omitClaudeMd: zero hits, new. The empty-day streak recorded 10–14 Sep is broken by a substantive release, not a one-line regression fix. (i) Per-command allowed_domains on Bash, PowerShell and Monitor in auto mode with sandboxing — egress scoped per COMMAND rather than per session, the same surface as coworkEgressAllowedHosts pushed one level finer. (ii) omitClaudeMd in agent frontmatter and --agents JSON, letting custom and plugin subagents run WITHOUT user, project and local CLAUDE.md files — per-subagent context isolation as a flag. Also: fast mode in Claude Code Remote sessions (cloud and self-hosted runners), claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file, mouse support in /config fullscreen, fixes across VS Code, web app, Claude Tag, Code Review, Windows.
bullets.how: YES — and note what broke the streak: a real release, found at the primary, on the sixth check. The five-day finding was correct each day it was made and is now correctly closed, which is what a negative result is FOR. Substantively, allowed_domains is directly relevant to a credentialed executor holding one long-lived deploy key with unscoped reach, and omitClaudeMd is the first vendor-shipped answer to a problem we have only ever discussed in prose — a ~130-file corpus loaded into every subagent whether or not it needs it. It costs one frontmatter line to test on a single agent.

bullets.title: AN MCP-NATIVE AGENT PLATFORM SHIPPED WITH AUDITABILITY AND DATA RESIDENCY AS THE PRODUCT, NOT THE FINE PRINT — FUND RECS PUTS FIVE NAMED AGENTS INSIDE ITS OVERSIGHT LAYER, THREE ALREADY IN PRODUCTION
bullets.summary: Archive grep: zero prior hits. Support, document-extraction, template-builder, resolution and controls agents run inside the existing reconciliation oversight layer; built on open MCP; client data never leaves the environment; operating model stated explicitly — agents prepare work, humans review and sign off, outputs feed deterministic rules where required. Sold to regulated firms that cannot trade auditability or data residency for automation.
bullets.how: YES, for PRAGMA specifically — the third enterprise vendor in two weeks to put a system of record behind MCP (after Docusign, GA 30 Sep, and Salesforce/ServiceNow before it), but the first whose MARKETING is the audit trail rather than the autonomy. That is the AAIR shape appearing in someone else's product: a buyer sold "agents prepare, humans sign, outputs are inspectable" is already primed for a published third-party score. It also names the honest autonomy ceiling for regulated clients — prepare-and-review, not act-and-notify — a more sellable promise than full autonomy and one we can deliver today. Sourcing caveat kept deliberately: this reached us through a weekly aggregator rather than a vendor primary, so the claims are the vendor's and the item is reported at that confidence.

bullets.title: STANDING ACTIONS — DAY FIFTEEN. ONE ITEM CHANGED CATEGORY BECAUSE THE VENDOR SHIPPED ITS INSTRUMENT, AND THE COMPLETION COUNT IS STILL WHAT IT WAS
bullets.summary: CONFIG (unwritten): maxEffortLevel; --system-prompt-snapshot off; CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS still default against the post-14-Sep pool (permanent +25% over pre-May baseline, ~17% below the boost run through 13 Sep); (b) the four Entra MCP controls — TENTH asking, five lines. NEW THIS FIRE: per-command allowed_domains joins the config list, the first item with a security argument rather than a tidiness one — it scopes egress for the exact executor holding the unrotated deploy key. ARTIFACT: (a) incident log, six rows still in prose across five days, still not queryable; (c) skill-corpus audit — now THREE named instruments (/skill-doctor, Enterprise smart reports, and today omitClaudeMd as the remedy rather than the measurement) and ZERO runs. READ: RFC 9449, RFC 8707, body of arXiv 2609.00006. CARRIED: OPENROUTER_MODEL=deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash; which dsh / ls ~/.dsh; the launchd seam. DATED DEADLINES: Sonar 27 Sep (twelve days out), Docusign MCP GA 30 Sep, client-cert 17 Nov, DCR removal after summer 2027. KILLED ON PRIOR COVERAGE: arXiv 2602.05447 (already 26 Aug, 27 Aug, 8 Sep, 10 Sep); Gimlet Labs $300M Series B (already 5 Sep). KILLED ON DATELINE: Crusoe ~$3B (3 Sep), the Gemini 3.8 Flash / GPT-6 Astra cluster (1–3 Sep).
bullets.how: YES — with the observation the day earns: three instruments now point at standing action (c) and none has been run, and the corpus they would measure is the same asset bullet 1 just revalued upward. An asset worth more is an asset worth auditing sooner, not later.

praxis_lesson: THE VENDOR SHIPPED OUR ARCHITECTURE AS A PRODUCT AND OUR CONTEXT-ISOLATION PROBLEM AS A FLAG, ON THE SAME DAY — WHICH IS VALIDATION AND A CLOCK IN ONE ENVELOPE. Claude for Financial Advisors is not a model release; it is eight named workflow skills and a list of connectors, which is a public statement that skills-plus-connectors is the unit of a vertical AI product. That ends an argument PRAGMA has been making without a citation. It also starts a timer, because the lab now ships the vertical packs itself, top-down, per industry — and the only ground it cannot take from headquarters is the ground it has no access to: documented local relationships, client-proprietary workflow, provable provenance. Build there, not adjacent to whatever a lab productizes next quarter. SECOND LESSON, ON NEGATIVE RESULTS CLOSING PROPERLY: "nothing shipped" ran five days, was true on each of them, and ended today at the primary on the sixth check. That is what a recorded gap is supposed to do — close on evidence or keep costing a check. Compare standing action (b), at its tenth asking, with no external party who will ever close it for us. The report now has a clean contrast between its two kinds of open item: the kind someone else resolves, and the kind only we can. Five days of the first closed itself this morning; fifteen days of the second have not moved. THIRD, ON THE ONE-LINE FIX SITTING IN TODAY'S CHANGELOG: omitClaudeMd is a single frontmatter key that stops a ~130-file corpus loading into subagents that do not need it. Standing action (c) has been carried nine days, accumulated three instruments, and produced zero runs — and today the ecosystem handed us not just another way to MEASURE the problem but the switch that FIXES it. The distance between "we have three instruments" and "we ran one" is the entire distance between this report and an outcome.
